blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The dominant recipe for improving language models is remarkably simple: scale the model, the data, and the compute, and optimize next-token prediction (NTP) ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . Under this paradigm, the training process—primarily gradient-based optimization—is trusted not only to learn the predictive task, but also to discover how the information required for that task should be internally represented.
blocks.zh: 改进语言模型的主要食谱非常简单:模型、数据和计算,以及优化下接预测(NTP)(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年)。 在这一范式下,培训进程——主要是梯度优化——不仅可以学习预测性任务,而且可以发现如何在内部反映这项任务所需的信息。

blocks.en: We ask a different question: should representation structure itself be an inductive bias?
blocks.zh: 我们提出另一个问题:代表结构本身是否应该是一种诱导性偏见?

blocks.en:
A principled starting point is the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity. An object can be described by first specifying a structure Z Z , and then specifying the residual information required to recover
the particular realization X X : 𝖪 ⁡ ( X ) ≤ 𝖪 ⁡ ( Z ) + 𝖪 ⁡ ( X ∣ Z ) + O ⁡ ( 1 ) . \mathsf{K}(X)\leq\mathsf{K}(Z)+\mathsf{K}(X\mid Z)+O(1). This suggests a general inductive principle for language models: encourage internal representations to discover a favorable balance between structure and residual.

blocks.en: What should such structure look like in a language model? We draw inspiration from two basic functions involved in language modeling.
blocks.zh: 这种结构在语言模型中应该是什么样子? 我们从语言建模的两个基本功能中汲取灵感。

blocks.en:
First, perception often involves abstraction. Phrases such as “France’s capital” and “the capital of France” differ at the token level but share substantial predictive structure. This suggests compressing information that must be carried across spans into a compact representation. However, a structure-only representation is insufficient: the exact surface realization still matters for autoregressive prediction.
Motivated by this structure–residual balance, we introduce Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC), which routes information from a completed segment to later segments through a boundary carrier while preserving ordinary token-level autoregression within the current segment (Figure 1(a) ). Related approaches include MEGABYTE’s
combination of global patch modeling and local autoregressive byte decoding ( Yu et al., 2023a ) , and gist tokens that compress prompt information
through attention bottlenecks ( Mu et al., 2023 ) . BBC instead uses existing
segment-end states as carriers.

blocks.en:
Second, generation requires fine positional information: every token position remains potentially relevant to the next-token distribution. This appears to leave little room for structural compression. Yet positional detail need not imply arbitrary representational complexity. A sequence of hidden states may preserve every token position while still admitting a simple underlying trajectory. Motivated by this observation, we study Continuous Concept (CC), which
encourages neighboring hidden states to vary smoothly (Figure 1(b) ). We analyze a spectral structure–residual decomposition: low-frequency modes form the structured component, while CC energy bounds the high-frequency residual and its finite-precision index length under a shared coding convention.

blocks.en: On GPT-2 Small, BBC improves evaluation NLL by approximately 0.99 % 0.99\% at 300M training tokens, while BBC+CC improves it by 1.30 % 1.30\% . On a deeper GPT-2 Medium model, the gains are 1.11 % 1.11\% and 1.44 % 1.44\% , respectively. BBC is not explained by sparsity alone: same-density sliding-window and random sparse-attention controls do not reproduce its gain, and randomizing the location of BBC carriers significantly degrades performance. Similarly, CC is not explained by either of its two components. Their improvements also persist with longer training, reaching 1.12 % 1.12\% for BBC and 1.26 % 1.26\% for BBC+CC through our 20B-token runs.

blocks.en:
Our empirical study also reveals that the two biases favor different depths. BBC works best near
the bottom of the network, while CC is most effective at
later layers. Interestingly, the depth asymmetry is consistent with the broader intuition that different depths of a Transformer perform different computational roles: earlier representations can benefit from compact cross-span structure, whereas later representations retain fine token-level access while benefiting from simpler feature geometry.

blocks.en: Our results suggest that scaling NTP is not the only lever for improving language-model training. Explicit biases on how information is represented can improve the same predictive objective.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,扩大NTP并不是改进语言模式培训的唯一杠杆。 如何反映信息的明显偏见可以改善同样的预测目标。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We use the two-part coding principle to analyze structure–residual inductive biases in language-model representations. • We introduce BBC, which compresses cross-segment communication through boundary carriers, and characterize CC as a spectral structure–residual bias with explicit reconstruction and residual-description bounds; their parameters K K and β \beta set the balance. • We find that BBC and CC favor different depths, outperform matched architectural and regularization controls, and deliver gains that persist across model sizes and long training horizons; the K K and β \beta sweeps are U-shaped, consistent with this role.

blocks.en: Setup. We pre-train gpt2-small and gpt2-medium models ( Radford et al., 2019 ) with context length N = 1024 N=1024 on a randomly sampled 1B-token subset of FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate on a 1M-token holdout set sampled from the same dataset and report holdout NLL. The primary runs use a cosine learning-rate schedule over 1B tokens with a 5M-token linear warmup. To reduce compute, hyperparameter sweeps and ablations are evaluated after 100M or 300M training tokens while retaining the same 1B-token learning-rate decay schedule. Unless otherwise noted, we use three seeds, { 82 , 23 , 37 } \{82,23,37\} , and report mean and standard deviation. For the 20B-token runs, we enlarge the holdout set to 10M tokens and use a single seed (82) to reduce computational cost.

blocks.en: BBC and CC are depth-dependent. Our first finding is a clear depth dependence for both methods. We sweep the intervention layer over the even-numbered Transformer layers for both gpt2-small and gpt2-medium , using K ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } K\in\{4,8,16\} for BBC and β ∈ { 0.00125 , 0.0025 , 0.005 } \beta\in\{0.00125,0.0025,0.005\} for CC (Figure 2 and also Table 2 , 3 in Appendix A.1 ). The same qualitative pattern appears across both model sizes: BBC is most effective when applied at lower layers, whereas CC becomes more effective toward higher layers. This depth asymmetry was not built into either method. Interestingly, it is consistent with the motivating intuition that BBC is perception-inspired while CC is generation-inspired, suggesting that different Transformer depths may favor different representational functions.

blocks.en:
Representation learning for LLMs. Representation learning has been central to self-supervised learning
in vision, where joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) ( Assran et al., 2023 ) learn semantic representations through
embedding-space prediction.
Recent work brings related ideas to language:
LLM-JEPA ( Huang et al., 2026a ) incorporates JEPA-style objectives
into language-model training, while Semantic Tube Prediction (STP) ( Huang et al., 2026b ) introduces a geometric prior on hidden-state
trajectories.
Large Concept Models ( LCM Team et al., 2024 ) perform
autoregressive prediction in a sentence-level embedding space.
Our work shares the general motivation and introduces principled structure–residual inductive biases.

and CC’s spectral representations, retaining both structure and residual costs without

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we introduced BBC and CC as complementary structure–residual inductive biases for language-model pretraining and derived explicit bounds characterizing both mechanisms. BBC compresses cross-segment communication through boundary carriers, while CC encourages compact spectral structure in hidden-state trajectories. We further give a qualitative connection between the two and find that BBC favors early layers, whereas CC favors later layers. Their gains persist across model sizes and training horizons up to 20B tokens, demonstrating that explicit representation biases can improve next-token pretraining.
blocks.zh: 基于科尔莫戈罗夫复杂程度的两部分编码观点,我们引入了BBC和CC作为补充结构 — — 语言模型预训的剩余诱导性偏差,并衍生出两种机制特征的明确界限。 BBC压缩通过边界载体进行跨区间通信,而CC则鼓励在隐藏状态轨迹中的紧凑光谱结构. 我们进一步给出两者之间的质的关联,发现BBC倾向于早期层,而CC则倾向于后期层. 它们在模式规模和培训视野方面持续取得收益,最高达20B个标志,表明明确的代表性偏差可以改善下手预训。

training signal that teaches the model when to terminate the generation. Models with distinct EOS and PAD tokens are unaffected. We flagged this to the authors, who

After fixing the bug, we reproduced the results using Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on the NL-RX-SYNTH dataset. NTP
accuracy rose sharply, from 62.35% to 86.2%, while STP improved more modestly, from 84.35% to 86.31%.
This gap suggests that STP is notably more robust to this failure mode than NTP. To
probe this further, we ran a preliminary experiment masking the last two tokens. After one
epoch, STP recovered to 72.55% accuracy, compared to 25.4% for NTP. This robustness did not extend
to masking more than two tokens, however. Understanding why STP is able
to partially recover from this kind of signal loss, while NTP is not, remains an interesting
direction for future work.
